description: Central Province - Order Passed by the Road Passenger Transport Services Authority of the Central Provincial Council
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns the establishment of new regulatory requirements and operational procedures for passenger transport services in the Central Province. It revokes previous orders and introduces detailed regulations covering electronic ticketing systems, GPS/CCTV technology requirements, financial management procedures, audit requirements, and service quality standards. The content focuses on creating a legal/regulatory framework for transport operations rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
